title: Regression suite to prevent quality regressions
description: Added regression script that validates similarity/wer/click metrics against thresholds.

title: Benchmark Vevo local inference on M3 Max
description: Measure Vevo vevotimbre/vevovoice streaming window inference time on macOS (MPS vs CPU) and decide if fully local live VC is feasible.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Bench (M3 Max, torch mps): vevotimbre win=1000 hop=500 steps=8 mean=0.521s (rtf=1.04, borderline slow); steps=6 mean=0.395s (rtf=0.79, realtime). vevotimbre win=600 hop=600 steps=8 mean=0.495s (rtf=0.83, realtime). CPU win=1000 hop=500 steps=8 mean=5.29s (rtf=10.6). vevovoice mps win=1000 hop=1000 steps=8 mean=2.59s (rtf=2.59, not realtime).

title: Strengthen live VC eval + auto-tune best macOS streaming config
description: Add deterministic playlist builder and strengthen search/regress gates (WER/rtf_p95) to find best window/hop/steps on M3 Max.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Added deterministic playlist builder (evaluation/vevo_live/build_playlist.py) + two-stage macOS tuner (evaluation/vevo_live/tune_macos.py), fixed search.py fade-grid bug, and established new stable macOS presets (steps4 2000w/2000h and 1500w/1500h) validated by regress on a deterministic GLOBE playlist.

title: Candidate: Noro (noise-robust) zero-shot VC
description: Evaluate Amphion Noro one-shot VC as a low-latency timbre VC candidate: obtain pretrained checkpoint + HuBERT/kmeans, run offline + streaming sim, measure metrics + speed, store artifacts under runs/vc_quest/noro/.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Decision: defer Noro eval for now. Noro inference is diffusion over mel frames (reverse_diffusion loop) and also needs a compatible mel vocoder (hop=200/win=800) which is not bundled; likely to miss realtime targets. Revisit only if FreeVC/YingMusic/FACodec listening results are unsatisfactory.

title: Vevo live: polish client/server UX
description: Add clearer CLI docs for port forwarding and audio device selection; consider server-side backpressure/queue and optional limiter/AGC smoothing.

title: Candidate: FACodec (NaturalSpeech3) zero-shot VC
description: Evaluate amphion/naturalspeech3_facodec VC as a low-latency timbre VC candidate: offline + streaming sim on user pair, objective metrics + artifact gates, copy listen artifacts under runs/vc_quest/facodec/.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Ran FACodec on Vast RTX 4090. Extremely fast (RTF_mean≈0.175 @ w600/h300) and stable (drop=0, leak_p95≈-44 to -47dB), but intelligibility is inconsistent on our user pair: v5->fr WER≈0.91 offline / 0.77 stream; fr->v5 WER≈0.42 offline / 0.46 stream. Artifacts copied to runs/vc_quest/facodec/user_pair/.

title: Add local live VC runner (Mac/MPS)

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Implemented single-process local live VC runner (mic -> Vevo -> playback) at models/vc/vevo/live_local.py and documented usage in models/vc/vevo/README.md.

title: Candidate: ChatterboxVC (ResembleAI)
description: Evaluate ResembleAI ChatterboxVC as a low-latency timbre VC backend (offline + streaming sim) and compare to Vevo-online + FreeVC using existing scorer.
acceptance_criteria: Produces offline + streaming outputs for user pair; generates report JSONs; summary + ranking updated in docs/vc_quest.md.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Ran ChatterboxVC (ResembleAI/chatterbox) on RTX 4090. Config: cfm_timesteps=10, watermark=true, stream w800/h400 fade=10, emit_align=center, WebRTC VAD. Results: Offline v5->fr S-SIM≈0.911 WER≈0.604; fr->v5 S-SIM≈0.858 WER≈0.482. Stream v5->fr S-SIM≈0.958 WER≈0.681 leak_p95≈-37.2dB drop≈0.0007; fr->v5 S-SIM≈0.963 WER≈0.736 leak_p95≈-42.7dB drop≈0.0. Speed: p95_window≈0.437s => RTF_p95≈1.09 @ hop=0.4s (borderline slower than realtime). Artifacts+reports copied to mac: runs/vc_quest/chatterbox/user_pair/*; summary added to docs/vc_quest.md.

title: Live buffered Vevo conversion: mic -> buffer -> inference -> playback
description: Implemented buffered live pipeline via websocket server (GPU) + local client (mic/playback) with window/hop buffering, length normalization, and boundary crossfades.

title: VC quest: low-latency timbre VC
description: Find/implement a timbre VC model that supports smaller streaming windows (<=600ms) while matching Vevo timbre quality. Start with known strong baselines (not random) and integrate with our deterministic eval harness.
acceptance_criteria: At least one alternative model runs offline + simulated-live with chunk<=600ms and scores competitively vs Vevo; clear comparison report + artifacts.

title: Candidate: OpenVoice tone-color VC
description: Fork/clone OpenVoice (myshell-ai/OpenVoice) and build minimal offline + streaming wrapper + deterministic eval integration.
acceptance_criteria: Produces offline + live-sim outputs for our user pair; eval report generated.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Note: GITHUB_TOKEN is fine-grained (Amphion-only), cannot fork external repos (403 on myshell-ai/OpenVoice). Plan: clone upstream repo locally for inspection; keep wrappers + any patch files inside Amphion and apply patches during GPU setup.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Ran OpenVoice V2 tone-color converter (offline + 600ms stream sim) on RTX 4090. Speed is excellent (~30ms per 600ms window). Speaker sim is high (~0.95–0.97) but content preservation is poor by Whisper WER on our sample pair (offline WER≈0.69–0.84, stream WER≈0.70–0.93). Streaming artifacts improved after aligning sim (drop warmup hops), but quality still not competitive for VC. Artifacts + reports in runs/vc_quest/openvoice/user_pair/; summary in docs/vc_quest.md. Marking as likely reject, moving to FreeVC.

title: Candidate: YingMusic-SVC (zero-shot singing VC)
description: Evaluate GiantAILab/YingMusic-SVC as a zero-shot VC candidate for speech: offline + streaming sim, objective metrics + artifact gates, listen artifacts under runs/vc_quest/yingmusic_svc/.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Ran YingMusic-SVC on RTX 4090 (offline + stream-sim). Baseline w600/h300/steps20 is not realtime (mean window ~0.48s => RTF~1.6), but tuning to steps=10 makes it barely realtime (mean window ~0.29s => RTF~0.97) with better WER on v5->fr (stream WER~0.49, S-SIM~0.94). Artifacts: runs/vc_quest/yingmusic_svc/user_pair/* (steps20) and runs/vc_quest/yingmusic_svc/user_pair_w600_h300_s10/* (steps10). Keep as candidate pending listening/robustness; evaluated task complete.

title: Candidate: SaMoye-SVC (zero-shot singing VC)
description: Evaluate CarlWangChina/SaMoye-SVC as a zero-shot VC candidate for speech: offline + streaming sim, objective metrics + artifact gates, listen artifacts under runs/vc_quest/samoye_svc/.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Ran SaMoye-SVC on RTX 4090 (offline + stream-sim) with w600/h300/crossfade10/fp16. Very fast (mean window ~0.073s => RTF~0.24), but content preservation is poor on our user pair (high Whisper WER: offline v5->fr ~0.80, fr->v5 ~0.67; stream v5->fr ~0.93, fr->v5 ~1.07). Speaker similarity is decent (e.g., fr->v5 ~0.92–0.93). Artifacts: runs/vc_quest/samoye_svc/user_pair/*. Likely reject.

title: Candidate: FreeVC
description: Fork/clone FreeVC and build minimal offline + streaming wrapper + deterministic eval integration.
acceptance_criteria: Produces offline + live-sim outputs for our user pair; eval report generated.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Ran FreeVC candidate (variant=freevc-24) on RTX 4090 with 600ms stream chunks. Offline: v5->fr S-SIM≈0.952 WER≈0.659; fr->v5 S-SIM≈0.880 WER≈0.847. Stream (600/600): v5->fr degrades badly (WER≈0.945), fr->v5 better (WER≈0.648). Mean 600ms window inference ≈77ms, so real-time is feasible; main issue is quality/content preservation + silence noise. Artifacts+reports in runs/vc_quest/freevc/user_pair/*, summary in docs/vc_quest.md. Next: try overlap (hop < window) + variant sweep.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Ran FreeVC streaming grid search (freevc-24) with improved wrapper: WebRTC VAD + hangover, prefix crossfade, emit_align=center. Best by mean WER (quality-tier gates: min S-SIM>=0.85, silent_out_p95<=-25dB, dropout<=0.01): w800/h200 (mean_WER≈0.580, min_S-SIM≈0.858, leak_p95≈-30.2dB, drop≈0.004, rtf_p95≈0.359). Best by speaker/noise: w800/h400 (mean_WER≈0.594, min_S-SIM≈0.875, leak_p95≈-32.2dB, drop≈0.003, rtf_p95≈0.174). Artifacts+reports in runs/vc_quest/freevc/user_pair_search_webrtc_center/*; summary updated in docs/vc_quest.md.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Compared against Vevo (runs/vevo_live/user_pair) using the same scorer (Whisper base WER + WavLM S-SIM). Vevo offline: v5->fr S-SIM≈0.888 WER≈0.762; fr->v5 S-SIM≈0.963 WER≈0.432. Vevo online files you flagged as noisy: v5->fr WER≈0.866 dropout≈0.036; fr->v5 WER≈0.636 dropout≈0.123 and silence leak p95≈-21.8dB. FreeVC best streaming (w800/h400) is much more stable (drop≈0.0005–0.003) with similar WER in this user pair, but Vevo offline preserves target speaker identity better for fr->v5.

title: Candidate: MeanVC (streaming zero-shot VC)
description: Evaluate MeanVC (ASLP-lab) as a low-latency, streaming, zero-shot timbre VC candidate. Integrate with our deterministic eval harness (offline + streaming-sim), run RTX 4090 benchmark, and record metrics/artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Offline + streaming-sim outputs produced and scored; best streaming config selected (<=600ms if viable); notes recorded in docs/vc_quest.md.
close_reason: Not competitive vs FreeVC/Vevo on content (WER) and stability (dropouts); keep as rejected candidate.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Ran MeanVC (streaming zero-shot, 200ms) on Vast RTX 4090. CPU vocoder decode workaround needed (CUDA TorchScript vocos.decode fails after repeated calls w/ UNSUPPORTED DTYPE: complex). Speed is great: stream w200/h200 p95_window≈0.050s => rtf_p95≈0.25. But quality is not competitive on our user pair: offline WER≈0.935/1.000 (v5->fr/fr->v5), stream WER≈0.942/1.011; min S-SIM≈0.744; dropouts high (max dropout_frac_voiced≈0.084); leak_p95≈-23.4dB. Artifacts+reports: runs/vc_quest/meanvc/user_pair/*

title: Candidate: Seed-VC (zero-shot VC)
description: Evaluate Seed-VC as a low-latency, streaming, zero-shot timbre VC candidate. Integrate with our deterministic eval harness, run RTX 4090 benchmark, and record metrics/artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Offline + streaming-sim outputs produced and scored; best streaming config selected; notes recorded in docs/vc_quest.md.
close_reason: Fails streaming artifact gates (silence leakage + dropouts)

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Ran Seed-VC (xlsr-tiny realtime model) on Vast RTX 4090. Offline is decent: v5->fr S-SIM≈0.946 WER≈0.610; fr->v5 S-SIM≈0.860 WER≈0.318. Streaming sim (SOLA wrapper, rms VAD -55dB, extra_ce=2.5s extra=0.5s right=0.02s, crossfade=40ms) is fast (w300/h300 p95_window≈0.136s => RTF_p95≈0.45; w600/h600 p95_window≈0.139s => RTF_p95≈0.23) but fails artifact gates: loud silence leakage (max leak_p95≈-9dB) and high voiced dropouts (max≈0.056 @ w300; worse @ w600). Artifacts+reports: runs/vc_quest/seedvc/user_pair/*; best_streaming tier fell back to rtf_only.

title: Candidate: kNN-VC (no-training retrieval VC)
description: Evaluate bshall/knn-vc as a zero-shot timbre VC candidate: offline + streaming-sim, run objective metrics + artifact gates, produce listen artifacts under runs/vc_quest/knnvc/.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Ran kNN-VC (bshall/knn-vc) on RTX 4090 with prematched HiFiGAN, topk=4, tgt_loudness_db=none. Streaming sim: window=600ms hop=300ms fade=10ms VAD=WebRTC (emit_align=center). Speed: p95_window_sec≈0.034s => RTF_p95≈0.06 (very fast). Quality on user pair: offline v5->fr S-SIM≈0.929 WER≈0.901; fr->v5 S-SIM≈0.977 WER≈0.909. Streaming: v5->fr S-SIM≈0.944 WER≈0.872 dropout≈0.0246 (fails gate); fr->v5 S-SIM≈0.977 WER≈0.870 dropout≈0.0008. Conclusion: high speaker sim + fast, but poor content preservation (high WER) and occasional streaming dropouts → likely reject.

title: Candidate: SpeechT5 voice conversion (zero-shot)
description: Evaluate Microsoft SpeechT5 VC (transformers) as a zero-shot timbre VC candidate: offline + streaming-sim, run objective metrics + artifact gates, produce listen artifacts under runs/vc_quest/speecht5/.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Ran SpeechT5 VC (microsoft/speecht5_vc + speecht5_hifigan) on RTX 4090, speaker conditioning via WavLM xvector (wavlm-base-plus-sv). Added workaround to extend decoder positional encoding (encode_positions.pe) and installed sentencepiece. Results are not competitive: streaming win=600ms hop=300ms fade=10ms has p95_window_sec≈1.55s (RTF_p95≈2.6, not realtime). Quality is poor with loud silence leakage + dropouts: v5->fr offline S-SIM≈0.771 WER≈0.986 leak_p95≈-13.6dB drop≈0.053; fr->v5 offline S-SIM≈0.687 WER≈2.57 leak_p95≈-16.1dB drop≈0.081; streaming v5->fr S-SIM≈0.703 WER≈0.973 leak_p95≈-17.7dB drop≈0.064; fr->v5 S-SIM≈0.505 WER≈1.00 leak_p95≈-20.9dB drop≈0.045. Conclusion: fails realtime + artifact gates; reject.

title: Candidate: EZ-VC (zero-shot any-to-any VC)

comments.author: kind
comments.text: GPU env setup OK (conda ezvc + f5-tts + espnet xeus). Blocking issue: GPU host has no HF auth; SPRINGLab/EZ-VC weights are gated, so runs fail until you do 'huggingface-cli login' on vastai-gpu-1. Proceeding with other candidates while waiting.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: EZ-VC now runs on Vast RTX 4090 (BigVGAN). Results on user pair are poor: very high WER (offline 0.62–0.95, stream 0.83–0.86) and loud silence leakage (leak_p95 up to ~-6.8dB). Stream speed mean_window_sec≈0.43s for 600ms windows => not realtime at hop=300ms. Artifacts: runs/vc_quest/ezvc/user_pair/*.

title: Live Vevo quality tuning + DSP polish
description: Tune window/hop/crossfade and add light DSP (HPF/DC, limiter/softclip, VAD smoothing) to reduce glitches; validate with evaluation/vevo_live search + regress thresholds.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Improved live stability by replacing tail-mix crossfade with boundary smoothing; updated evaluation/vevo_live/best_configs/vevotimbre.json (fade=10) and tuned regress defaults for VC.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Implemented LibriTTS test-clean sources via HF dataset mythicinfinity/libritts; stylestream_test preset now uses 50% GLOBE + 50% LibriTTS and records libritts_revision in manifest meta.

title: Fix live_local streaming noise (window/hop) + deterministic quality gate
description: Live local sim outputs are noisy with 600-1000ms windows. Update streaming config search/presets to use >=1500ms windows, enforce realtime constraint, and add regression gate (WER/content) to catch noise.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Fixed live_local noise by moving streaming defaults/presets to window=2000ms hop=1000ms; search now sweeps window_ms + enforces rtf<=1 + constant eval_seconds; regress tightened max_wer default to 0.9. Commit: 0a8d19b.

title: Paper-comparable eval vs StyleStream (WER/S-SIM/A-SIM/E-SIM)
description: Add an evaluation mode that matches StyleStream paper objective metrics: Whisper-large-v3 WER vs transcript, Resemblyzer speaker similarity, accent similarity via Jzuluaga accent-id ecapa, emotion similarity via emotion2vec, plus deterministic StyleStream-like dataset subset + report.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Patched Vast scripts to override HF cache vars (HF_HOME/HF_DATASETS_CACHE/TRANSFORMERS_CACHE) to /root/.cache/huggingface so eval downloads stop filling /workspace. Next: rerun stylestream_like smoke + full eval on Vast and record baseline report.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Vast fixes: HF cache moved off /workspace; pinned datasets<3 + added addict/simplejson/sortedcontainers for modelscope emotion2vec; pinned ruamel.yaml<0.19. Smoke stylestream_like eval works with USE_EMOTION=1. Ran vevotimbre eval (NUM_SOURCES=30, PAIRS_PER_SOURCE=10, FLOW_STEPS=16, Whisper large-v3): mean WER=0.0449, S-SIM=0.7727, A-SIM=0.4015, E-SIM=0.9528 (300 pairs) under runs/stylestream_like_30src.

title: Fix live online noise/dropouts

acceptance_criteria: Online simulated outputs (live_local) no longer exhibit gain pumping/noise bursts or audible dropouts compared to offline; regression metrics catch these artifacts.

comments.author: kind
comments.text: Fix: removed per-window RMS normalization; added VAD gating + peak limiter to live_local/live_server/live_client + simulate_streaming; added artifact metrics + gates (silence leakage/dropouts/clipping) to search/regress. Commit: 123bedc.
